parts:
Hi folks,

I am looking into the quick guide of Geomorph, in particular to the analyses:

• Single-factor MANCOVA: y ~ x * a [means a + x + a:x, where : denotes interaction], e.g., Does
shape differ between sexes (a), while accounting for shape covarying with size (x)?
• Multiple-factor MANOVA: y ~ a + b, e.g., Does shape differ between sexes as well as localities (b)?

And I would like to know if there is any thread in the past who speaks about the interpretation of the results of these two analyses. 

Thank you very much!

Best,

Nicole
